item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00700","case1_error":"Unsupported 74; arithmetic averaging gives 40, but actual average travel speed requires unspecified ride durations.","case2_error":"Adds both workers’ times for completing the entire workload, duplicating work and ignoring simultaneous optimal allocation.","reason":"The first question ambiguously specifies average speed without ride durations; the second clearly misrepresents shared concurrent work.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00701","case1_error":"Divides by two again after writing 120/2, obtaining 30; final 15 is also unsupported.","case2_error":"Ignores scheduled purchases and losses in its inventory updates and invents an increase after game eleven.","reason":"The first incorrectly evaluates the average through repeated division; the second fails to apply the stated inventory events.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00702","case1_error":"Reorders cuts and calls 143 cm the final length; the question itself inconsistently describes which boards are shortened.","case2_error":"Invents an additional $5,000 material cost, reducing profit from $12,000 to $7,000.","reason":"The first question leaves the relevant boards and cutting relationship materially ambiguous. The second clearly introduces an unstated expense.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00703","case1_error":"States the correct difference expression but supplies unsupported final numbers, settling on 15 instead of 11.","case2_error":"States correct earnings formulas but supplies unsupported total 1350 instead of 1200.","reason":"Both append incorrect final numbers to correct formulas without showing a calculation that establishes a more specific arithmetic mistake.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00704","case1_error":"Reports 200 pairs instead of converting to the requested 400 individual plugs.","case2_error":"Treats all three initial packs as packs given away, despite the stated gift of one pack.","reason":"The first answers in the wrong counting unit; the second uses an erroneous relation for the quantity given away.","judgment":"different"}]}
